environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application on AWS ECS Fargate. LaunchDarkly SDK initialized with SDK key 'sdk-staging-yyyy'. The flag 'enhanced-profile-updates' has targeting set to ON with evaluation rules configured, however the off-variation is index 1 (false) and the flag's prerequisites include a dependent flag 'admin-panel-v2-rollout' which itself evaluates to false for all contexts because its kill-switch was activated on 2024-01-15 via the LD relay proxy configuration. When a prerequisite flag evaluates to its off-variation, the dependent flag ('enhanced-profile-updates') returns its off-variation regardless of its own targeting rules. The relay proxy runs as a sidecar container with configuration cached locally, TTL 300s, and the prerequisite state is persisted in the relay's Redis-backed feature store (ElastiCache r6g.large, single-AZ). Additionally, the LD SDK is initialized with a custom data store wrapper that logs all flag evaluations to CloudWatch, and the application config sets LAUNCHDARKLY_OFFLINE=false with streaming connection to the relay proxy on localhost:8030.
